description: Angular component for managing customers, including listing, creating, and deleting customers, with associated services and signals.

classes.name: CustomersComponent
classes.description: Angular component responsible for customer management operations such as listing, creating, and deleting customers.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component and loads the list of customers.

methods.name: loadCustomers
methods.description: Fetches all customers from the backend and updates the component state.

methods.name: toggleCreateForm
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the customer creation form.

methods.name: createCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer with the input form data.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer by ID after user confirmation.

methods.name: isDeleting
methods.description: Checks if a customer with specific ID is currently being deleted.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets the new customer form fields to default empty values.
